notes.title: New version available
notes.content:
Features:
Settings window (music and audio is coming)

Missions are generated during campaign and provide rewards

Enclaves in ruins can be explored by armies to find treasures

Stats/timeline window

Updated victory conditions

During campaign invasions are triggered (invader armies are enemies to everyone)

Added new faction and 3 new characters to choose from.


Join the discord
Join the Discord server to give feedback or report bugs.

notes.title: Battle Mode Demo
notes.content:
Hi Folks! A demo of Kingdom Wars will be available on April 30th

What to expect

 This demo covers the battle mode only (not the campaign).
 There will be 4 kings to choose from.
 Only 1v1 battle supported.
 You can custom your army before the battle.

Differences with the full game

 In campaign mode you will build cities, explore for new lands, research technologies, manage diplomacy, train armies and go to war against other kingdoms.
 There are 6 playable factions (18 kings to choose from) and one generic non-playable faction
 In battle mode you can create up to 3v3 battles.

Join the discord
Join the Discord server to give feedback or report bugs.
